runbooks.title: Pilot: healthcare content production (end-to-end)
runbooks.scope: One real client brief through the full 11-stage pipeline to a human-approved, review-ready deliverable, plus a full 194-agent workforce cycle and the enriched-vs-baseline A/B comparison.
prerequisites: docker compose stack up (ollama, backend, frontend)
originality check reviewed (known template families documented)
steps: A/B: rerun with SAMRUDHI_DISABLE_ENRICH=1 and compare first-pass acceptance
Negative test: seeded bad claim must be blocked by the safety gate
exit_criteria: deliverable published or a recorded, documented rejection
safety gate blocked the seeded bad claim
human gate paused the run and the decision is in the ledger
no new originality-check FAIL outside the documented template families
known_flags: SAM-AG-005/006/008 department-head skeleton (~91% prompt overlap) — accepted
SAM-AG-045/048-056 CEX responsibility skeleton (~82% overlap) — accepted
